title: Constraining the Inner Dark Matter Profiles of Strong-Lensing Galaxy Clusters
summary: We present mass modeling of three strong lensing galaxy clusters found in the Dark Energy Survey utilizing Hubble Space Telescope imaging for lens modeling, and complementary constraints from Chandra X-ray observations. All three clusters are relaxed and have giant arc or ring lens structures ideal for constraints on the dark matter distribution. The strong lens modeling and X-ray temperatures yield consistent total cluster mass estimates. We find these clusters have best-fit X-ray temperatures of $2.7 - 6.2$ keV and total masses of M$_{200} = (1-6) \times 10^{14} M_{\odot}$. Our lens models parameterize dark matter distribution with a generalized Navarro-Frenk-White (GNFW) density profile. While the GNFW profile allows the inner dark matter slope to vary, we find in all cases that the inner slopes are consistent with the standard NFW density profile $γ^{DM} = 1$. The X-ray surface brightness distributions for all three clusters are generally symmetric with no significant substructure, supporting the conclusion that these are relaxed clusters. In addition, we find generally low values of the external shear magnitude with median values ranging $|γ^{ext}| = 0.04-0.09$ and consistent with zero for two of the clusters.

title: SN Ares: A Strongly Lensed Type IIb Supernova at $\mathbf{z=1.276}$ with a Predicted 70-Year Time Delay
comment: 22 pages, 12 figures, 4 tables, submitted to ApJ
summary: We present the discovery of supernova (SN) Ares, a strongly lensed supernova at $z_{\rm spec}=1.276\pm0.002$ in a massive, triply imaged host galaxy behind the MACS J0308.9+2645 galaxy cluster. JWST/NIRSpec spectroscopy spanning the rest-frame optical to NIR of Ares reveals helium features at $5876\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$, $7065\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$, and $10830\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$, as well as H$α$ and Pa$β$. A comparison to local core-collapse SN spectra and light curves leads to a classification of SN Ares as a Type IIb supernova, the highest-redshift member of its class spectroscopically identified. A comparison to local SN IIb light curves provides a phase estimate for the spectrum of $34_{-9}^{+10}$ rest-frame days post-radioactive peak, providing a unique view into a high-redshift stripped-envelope supernova in its late-photospheric evolution. A lens model of the cluster constructed using recent JWST data indicates that SN Ares is the first image to arrive and will reappear in two future images near the center of the cluster plane in $\gtrsim 70$ years, with predicted magnifications of $\sim5\times$ and $\sim1.5\times$. Planned JWST/NIRSpec Multi-Object Spectroscopy of the cluster will allow for more detailed modeling of the lensed system for tighter constraints on the time delay and magnifications, as well as a template spectrum at the location of SN Ares.

title: Semi-Analytic Predictions for Strong-Lensing Perturbers in Cold and Self-Interacting Dark Matter
summary: Strong gravitational lensing is sensitive to the abundance and internal structure of dark matter halos, providing a probe of gravothermal evolution in self-interacting dark matter (SIDM). We combine semi-analytic cold dark matter (CDM) subhalo histories with a model for gravothermal evolution in SIDM to generate CDM and SIDM subhalo populations across SIDM parameter space. We predict their projected enclosed masses and deflection-based projected density slopes and compare them with three perturbers inferred through gravitational imaging in PJ011646, SDSS J0946+1006, and JVAS B1938+666. For SIDM model parameters $σ_0/m_χ=147.1$ cm$^2$/g and $w=120$ km/s, SIDM subhalos reproduce all three perturbers more often than CDM subhalos. For PJ011646, we find ~0.6 cored SIDM subhalos per host matching the perturber, compared with ~0.002 in CDM, while core-collapsed subhalos are too steep. For SDSS J0946+1006, we find ~3 core-collapsed and ~0.004 cored SIDM subhalos per host, compared with none in 900 CDM realizations, although baryons, neglected here, may matter for such massive subhalos. For "detection V" in JVAS B1938+666, we find ~220 core-collapsed and ~20 cored SIDM subhalos per host within the $2σ$ posterior region, compared with ~0.2 in CDM; the CDM candidates require exceptionally early accretion, at median redshift $z\sim13$. Simultaneously reproducing all three perturbers requires $w\gtrsim10^2$ km/s, so that the massive (~$5.6\times10^{10}M_\odot$) progenitors of SDSS J0946+1006 candidates can collapse, and is achieved for $σ_0/m_χ\gtrsim10^2$ cm$^2$/g in the parameter sets studied. Our results show how semi-analytic models can quantify how often subhalos reproduce individual perturbers in different dark matter models, and our modular framework can be readily updated as models of tidal stripping and late-stage gravothermal evolution in SIDM improve. (abridged)

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Density profiles assigned to SIDM subhalos, compared with the initial NFW profile (blue), with radius and density in units of the initial NFW scale radius \(r_{s,0}\) and scale density \(\rho_{s,0}\) . Subhalos with \(\tau(z_{lens})\leq 1.1\) are assigned the cored profile of Eq. ( 11 ) (red), and those with \(\tau(z_{lens})>1.1\) the collapsed profile of Slone et al. (2026) (orange). The dashed red curve shows the cored profile at “maximal core”, \(\tau\simeq 0.18\) , and the solid red curve shows it at the collapse threshold, \(\tau=1.1\) , as predicted by the gravothermal evolution model of Yang et al. (2024) . The collapsed profile has a constant-density core inside \(\approx 0.01\,r_{s,0}\) and is approximately \(\rho\propto r^{-2.2}\) outside it. The purple curve shows an alternative collapsed profile from Figure 1 of Gurian and May (2025) at \(t/t_{0}=437\) , where \(t_{0}\) is the characteristic scattering timescale of the initial NFW halo; this corresponds to \(\tau(t)\simeq 12.2\) under the convention of Eq. ( 1 ). Appendix B shows that our conclusions are robust to adopting this profile instead. All curves are shown without tidal truncation, except the dotted red curve, which shows the maximal-core profile truncated by the factor \((1+r/r_{t})^{-5}\) with \(r_{t}=r_{s,0}\) .

Scatter in the CDM structural evolution histories broadens the infall mass range over which the collapse fraction peaks, because gravothermal evolution depends on the time-dependent effective cross section and halo structural parameters in Eq. title: Gamma-ray Bursts as Cosmological Probes Calibrated with Strongly Lensed Quasars and Neural Networks
summary: Gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) extend distance measurements to redshifts beyond those routinely probed by Type Ia supernovae, but their use in cosmology is limited by calibration circularity and possible redshift-dependent effects. We investigate strongly lensed quasars as external calibrators of the Amati and Combo GRB relations. We reconstruct the luminosity-distance relation using an artificial neural network trained on TDCOSMO strong-lensing distances, with the absolute scale inherited from the lensing-only calibration. To avoid extrapolation, only GRBs within the lens-supported redshift interval are used for calibration. We then infer cosmological parameters through a hierarchical Bayesian analysis of flat $Λ$CDM, with $w_0w_a$CDM examined as a consistency test. For flat $Λ$CDM, Amati yields $H_0=78.26^{+17.87}_{-16.30}\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ and $Ω_m=0.670^{+0.223}_{-0.276}$, while Combo yields $H_0=78.71^{+13.83}_{-11.29}\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ and $Ω_m=0.635^{+0.235}_{-0.242}$. Amati is relatively insensitive to the phenomenological redshift term, whereas Combo shows a stronger dependence. Injection--recovery tests indicate that an unmodelled positive Combo trend can bias $H_0$ and $Ω_m$ upward. Strong-lens calibration therefore offers a route to extending the GRB Hubble diagram, but the inferred $H_0$ is not an independent GRB measurement: it retains the TDCOSMO distance scale. The precision is limited by GRB scatter, redshift-dependent systematics, and lens-modelling uncertainties.

title: Multiphase Gas Structure in JWST Little Red Dots
summary: JWST has uncovered a population of compact high-redshift galaxies, 'little red dots' (LRDs), exhibiting broad Balmer emission lines that often show narrow absorption features and strong Balmer breaks - spectral signatures attributed to dense gas surrounding rapidly growing black holes, but whose small-scale structure remains unknown. A striking feature of LRD spectra is that the H$β$ absorption is systematically deeper than H$α$, yet in any homogeneous gas this ordering is physically impossible. Here we model the H$α$ and H$β$ line profiles using radiative transfer simulations for 11 LRDs with JWST sensitive high resolution spectroscopy, and independently constrain the $n=2$ hydrogen column density, $N_{\rm HI,\mathit{n}=2}$, from the Balmer-break continuum. We find that the $N_{\rm HI,\mathit{n}=2}$ from H$α$ in a homogeneous medium cannot reproduce the observed H$β$ absorption in several objects, and that this $N_{\rm HI,\mathit{n}=2}$ typically falls two orders of magnitude below the lower bound set by the Balmer break. Both tensions are simultaneously resolved by a multiphase medium of dense clumps within diffuse hot ionized gas. This multiphase gas structure is a necessary ingredient for any viable LRD model, regardless of the nature of the central engine.

AI.method: 对11个具备JWST高分辨率灵敏光谱的LRD，用辐射转移模拟拟合Hα与Hβ线轮廓，并独立地从巴尔末跳跃连续谱约束n=2氢柱密度N_HI,n=2，比较均匀介质预测与观测及下界的一致性。

title: How Steep is your Dust? Direct Measurements of Nebular Attenuation Curves at Cosmic Noon with JWST
comment: 17 pages, 13 figures (+Appendix 3 pages, 6 figures), submitted to MNRAS, comments welcome
summary: Tracing the shape of the nebular attenuation curve, which is crucial for accurately measuring intrinsic emission-line fluxes, has proven challenging both in the local universe and at high redshift. Here we present nebular dust attenuation curves measured directly for 24 star-forming galaxies ($9.3<\log(\rm M{\star}/M_\odot)<11.1$) at cosmic noon ($1.8<z<3.3$) from the Blue Jay survey. Using deep JWST/NIRSpec spectra, we measure up to eight hydrogen recombination lines from H$δ$ to Pa$β$ per galaxy and find little diversity in the curve shape, with most galaxies agreeing with the \citet{calzetti_dust_2000} attenuation curve. For over $90\%$ of the sample, the nebular reddening from the Balmer lines is consistent with that from the Paschen lines. Using \texttt{Prospector} spectral energy distribution (SED) fits, we obtain the stellar reddening and find that the difference between stellar and nebular reddening increases with stellar mass, and that each reddening measurement is independent of inclination, which disagrees with the two-component dust model. We then measure the impact of using the derived nebular attenuation curve or a literature curve when determining metallicity using the strong-line method, and find that for some diagnostics (e.g., S32, S3, S23, and S3O3), the difference can be as large as $5σ$. Caution is needed when using these diagnostics if the nebular attenuation curve cannot be directly measured, since the resulting uncertainty can exceed the measurement uncertainty on the emission-line fluxes even with high signal-to-noise Balmer decrement measurements. These results show that the shape of the nebular attenuation curve is poorly understood and that constraining it is important for reducing systematic uncertainty in galaxy measurements.

title: Optical-Infrared Extinction Variation in Nearby Molecular Clouds
summary: The dust extinction curve is an important probe of the properties of dust grains, particularly their size distribution. The properties of dust grains are expected to change significantly in dense molecular clouds due to shielding from interstellar radiation and increased frequency of grain-grain and grain-gas collisions. We measure the dust extinction curve shape parameter R(V) in 9 nearby, dense molecular clouds using data from the APOGEE spectroscopic survey, in combination with ten-band photometry from PS1, 2MASS, and WISE. We analyze the results to determine how the extinction curve varies in nearby molecular clouds. We find that most molecular clouds show a positive correlation between R(V) and E(B-V), but the strength of the correlation varies significantly between clouds. In addition, we find that the clouds with the strongest correlation tend to have very high dispersion in R(V) at fixed E(B-V), which tightens dramatically when clouds are subdivided into separate regions. This suggests that local environmental conditions beyond density shape the R(V)-E(B-V) relation.

title: The H IX galaxy survey IV: What does the molecular gas reveal in HI eXtreme galaxies
summary: Galaxies with extreme amounts of neutral atomic hydrogen (HI), known as HI-eXtreme (HIX) galaxies, paradoxically exhibit normal or low star formation rates. To investigate the bottleneck in their star formation, we present ALMA CO(1-0) observations for five HIX survey galaxies: ESO208-G026, ESO378-G003, ESO381-G005, ESO417-G018, and ESO055-G013. While these systems possess massive, extended HI discs, their molecular gas discs are compact with normal H$_{2}$ masses relative to their stellar mass. Dynamical modelling with 3DBarolo reveals that the HI and molecular gas are kinematically consistent. Both gas phases show high velocity dispersions, indicating enhanced turbulence compared to regular late-type galaxies. We calculate the specific angular momentum for the stellar, atomic, and molecular components alongside the global stability parameter ($q$). Most of the system angular momentum is stored in the HI discs, rendering them globally stable against collapse. This stability suppresses the atomic-to-molecular gas conversion, as evidenced by extremely long HI depletion times contrasted with typical H$_{2}$ depletion times. The high angular momentum and HI excess likely originate from past gas accretion or recent tidal interactions; this is especially apparent in ESO378-G003 and ESO381-G005, which exhibit extended HI structures and positive tidal indices.

AI.tldr: 对五个HI-eXtreme星系开展ALMA CO(1-0)观测与3DBarolo动力学建模，发现其分子气体盘致密但质量正常，系统角动量主要存储于HI盘使其全局稳定，从而抑制原子到分子气体的转换，导致极长的HI耗尽时标。
AI.motivation: HIX星系拥有极端数量的中性原子氢却表现出正常甚至偏低的恒星形成率，这一悖论背后的恒星形成瓶颈机制尚不清楚，需要考察其分子气体含量、动力学状态与稳定性。
AI.method: 对ESO208-G026、ESO378-G003、ESO381-G005、ESO417-G018、ESO055-G013五个HIX巡天星系进行ALMA CO(1-0)观测；用3DBarolo进行动力学建模比较HI与分子气体的运动学一致性；计算恒星、原子、分子各组分的比角动量及全局稳定性参数q，并结合HI与H2耗尽时标和潮汐指数分析。
AI.result: 这些星系虽有巨大而延展的HI盘，但分子气体盘致密，H2质量相对恒星质量属正常水平；HI与分子气体运动学一致，两者速度弥散均偏高，显示比常规晚型星系更强的湍流；系统大部分角动量存于HI盘，使其全局稳定、难以坍缩，原子到分子气体转换被抑制，表现为极长的HI耗尽时标与典型的H2耗尽时标；ESO378-G003和ESO381-G005呈现延展HI结构和正潮汐指数。
AI.conclusion: HIX星系恒星形成受抑的主因是HI盘承载的高角动量带来的全局稳定性，而非分子气体匮乏；高角动量和HI过剩可能源于过去的 gas accretion 或近期潮汐相互作用。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 拥有极端量中性原子氢（HI）的星系，被称为HI极端（HIX）星系，却矛盾地表现出正常或较低的恒星形成率。为了探究其恒星形成过程中的瓶颈，我们对五个HIX巡天星系：ESO208-G026、ESO378-G003、ESO381-G005、ESO417-G018和ESO055-G013，进行了ALMA CO(1-0)观测。尽管这些系统拥有巨大且延展的HI盘，它们的分子气体盘却较为致密，且相对于其恒星质量具有正常的H$_{2}$质量。利用3DBarolo进行的动力学建模显示，HI和分子气体在运动学上是一致的。两种气体相都表现出高速度弥散，表明与常规晚型星系相比，其湍流增强。我们计算了恒星、原子和分子组分的比角动量以及全局稳定性参数（$q$）。系统的大部分角动量储存在HI盘中，使其在整体上对坍缩是稳定的。这种稳定性抑制了原子到分子气体的转换，这由极长的HI耗尽时间与典型的H$_{2}$耗尽时间形成对比所证明。高角动量和HI过剩可能源于过去的气体吸积或近期的潮汐相互作用；这在ESO378-G003和ESO381-G005中尤为明显，它们表现出延展的HI结构和正的潮汐指数。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：HIX星系恒星形成受抑的主因是HI盘承载的高角动量带来的全局稳定性，而非分子气体匮乏；高角动量和HI过剩可能源于过去的气体吸积或近期潮汐相互作用。

title: Unveiling the correlation between the UV 2175 Å dust attenuation bump, PAH emission, and gas-phase metallicity at cosmic noon
comment: Accepted for publication in A&A; 23 pages, 18 figures, 9 tables
summary: The UV 2175 Å attenuation bump is one of the most prominent yet poorly understood features of galaxy attenuation curves. Its main candidate carrier is polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) molecules, which are more prevalent in high-metallicity environments. We present the first systematic study of the relationship between PAH abundance and the UV bump in 49 galaxies at cosmic noon (1.5 < z < 2.7), examining its dependence on stellar mass, star formation rate (SFR), and V-band optical depth. For 19 galaxies, we also investigate gas-phase metallicity using oxygen abundances. We measure the bump amplitude from VLT/MUSE spectroscopy and derive galaxy properties, including the PAH-to-dust mass fraction $q_{\rm PAH}$, through spectral energy distribution fitting with Prospector, combining JWST/NIRCam and JWST/MIRI photometry. Oxygen abundances are derived from strong-line diagnostics using Keck/MOSFIRE and JWST/NIRSpec data. We find a positive correlation between bump amplitude $E_{\rm bump}$ and $q_{\rm PAH}$ (Spearman $ρ= 0.60$). UV bumps are rarely detected at low $q_{\rm PAH}$, supporting PAHs as their primary carriers. Both $E_{\rm bump}$ and $q_{\rm PAH}$ correlate with stellar mass, oxygen abundance, and optical depth, and anticorrelate with specific SFR, suggesting that PAHs and the UV bump are suppressed in low-metallicity, dust-poor, and/or intensely star-forming environments. This is consistent with PAH destruction in environments with limited dust shielding and/or strong radiation fields. A principal component analysis of $E_{\rm bump}$, $q_{\rm PAH}$, optical depth, specific SFR, and oxygen abundance explains 97% of the variance, suggesting that previously reported correlations with stellar mass reflect an underlying dependence on metallicity. Finally, variations in dust geometry may explain the wide range of bump amplitudes (0-0.5 mag) at high $q_{\rm PAH}$.

AI.tldr: 研究49个宇宙正午星系，首次系统证实UV 2175Å吸收凸起幅度与PAH质量分数正相关，并表明恒星质量相关性实为金属丰度依赖。
AI.motivation: 2175Å紫外衰减凸起是星系衰减曲线中最显著却最缺乏理解的特征之一，其主要候选载体PAH分子在高金属丰度环境中更普遍，但此前缺乏对PAH丰度与凸起关系在宇宙正午时期的系统观测检验。
AI.method: 对1.5<z<2.7的49个星系，用VLT/MUSE光谱测量凸起幅度E_bump；用Prospector结合JWST/NIRCam与MIRI测光做SED拟合，得到PAH-尘埃质量比q_PAH；对其中19个星系，用Keck/MOSFIRE与JWST/NIRSpec强线诊断求气相氧丰度；并用主成分分析考察E_bump、q_PAH、光学深度、sSFR与氧丰度的关系。
AI.result: E_bump与q_PAH呈正相关（Spearman ρ=0.60），低q_PAH处几乎探测不到UV凸起；E_bump与q_PAH均与恒星质量、氧丰度、光学深度正相关，与sSFR反相关。主成分分析解释97%的方差，表明此前报道的与恒星质量的相关性反映的是金属丰度这一潜在依赖。
AI.conclusion: PAH是UV凸起的主要载体，PAH与凸起在低金属丰度、贫尘埃和/或强恒星形成环境中被抑制，符合有限尘埃屏蔽或强辐射场下PAH被破坏的图像；在高q_PAH处凸起幅度仍跨越0–0.5 mag的宽范围，可能由尘埃几何差异所致。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 紫外2175 Å衰减凸起是星系衰减曲线中最显著但理解最少的特征之一。其主要候选载体是多环芳烃（PAH）分子，这类分子在高金属丰度环境中更为普遍。我们首次对宇宙正午（1.5 < z < 2.7）49个星系中PAH丰度与紫外凸起之间的关系进行了系统研究，考察了其对恒星质量、恒星形成率（SFR）和V波段光学深度的依赖性。对于其中19个星系，我们还利用氧丰度研究了气相金属丰度。我们从VLT/MUSE光谱测量凸起幅度，并通过Prospector结合JWST/NIRCam和JWST/MIRI测光进行光谱能量分布拟合，推导星系性质，包括PAH与尘埃质量比 $q_{\rm PAH}$。氧丰度利用Keck/MOSFIRE和JWST/NIRSpec数据通过强线诊断得到。我们发现凸起幅度 $E_{\rm bump}$ 与 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 之间存在正相关（Spearman $ρ= 0.60$）。在低 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 下很少探测到紫外凸起，支持PAH作为其主要载体。$E_{\rm bump}$ 和 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 均与恒星质量、氧丰度和光学深度相关，并与比恒星形成率反相关，表明PAH和紫外凸起在低金属丰度、贫尘埃和/或强恒星形成环境中受到抑制。这与在有限尘埃屏蔽和/或强辐射场环境中PAH被破坏的图像一致。对 $E_{\rm bump}$、$q_{\rm PAH}$、光学深度、比恒星形成率和氧丰度进行主成分分析可解释97%的方差，表明先前报道的与恒星质量的相关性反映了对金属丰度的潜在依赖。最后，尘埃几何的变化可能解释在高 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 下凸起幅度的宽范围（0-0.5 mag）。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要：PAH是紫外凸起的主要载体，PAH与凸起在低金属丰度、贫尘埃和/或强恒星形成环境中被抑制，符合有限尘埃屏蔽或强辐射场下PAH被破坏的图像；在高 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 处凸起幅度仍跨越0–0.5 mag的宽范围，可能由尘埃几何差异所致。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5 : Diagram illustrating two different scenarios that could explain the variation in \(E_{bump}\) at high \(q_{PAH}\) . In the first scenario, the young stellar population is obscured by a uniform dust screen; in this case, galaxies with high PAH abundances will exhibit strong UV bumps and high optical depths. In the second scenario, clumpy dust geometry gives rise to both obscured and unobscured young stellar populations. The UV-optical emission is dominated by the unobscured component, resulting in weak or absent bumps and low \(\tau_{V}\) . In contrast, the mid-IR emission, which traces PAHs, is dominated by the dusty regions, leading to high PAH abundances.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：示意图说明两种可解释高 $q_{PAH}$ 下 $E_{bump}$ 变化的场景。在第一种场景中，年轻星族被均匀尘埃屏遮蔽；此时，PAH丰度高的星系将表现出强紫外凸起和高光学深度。在第二种场景中，团块状尘埃几何同时产生被遮蔽和未被遮蔽的年轻星族。紫外-光学辐射由未被遮蔽成分主导，导致凸起微弱或缺失以及低 $\tau_{V}$。相反，追踪PAH的中红外辐射由尘埃区域主导，导致高PAH丰度。

title: Kinematically isolating intracluster light in AS1063: a distinct stellar population tracing the dark matter core
summary: We present a technique using integral-field spectroscopy to kinematically isolate intracluster light (ICL) from the brightest cluster galaxy (BCG), enabling insights into their contrasting stellar populations and the inner dark matter halo profile. Applying this technique to MUSE data of Abell S1063, we find that both components are old (~9 Gyr), but the ICL is more metal-poor than the BCG, implying distinct progenitor pathways. Within 100 kpc, the ICL comprises 55 per cent of the BCG+ICL stellar mass - substantially more than inferred from photometric decompositions. The BCG and ICL possess distinct velocity distributions, which remain nearly constant with radius, with an ICL velocity dispersion more than twice that of the BCG, and a line-of-sight velocity offset of 86 +- 18 km/s. Two-dimensional Sérsic fits yield an ICL centroid offset of 5.2 +- 1.5 kpc from the BCG. These phase-space offsets are indicative of the BCG oscillating in a broad potential minimum. Furthermore, the ICL surface-brightness profile matches that of strong-lensing estimates assuming a cored halo. Simulations indicate that the inner halo profile varies systematically for different dark matter models. Applied to larger samples, our method therefore offers a complementary route to testing the nature of dark matter, while simultaneously revealing the stellar origins of the ICL.

AI.tldr: 利用积分视场光谱从最亮团星系(BCG)中运动学分离内团光(ICL)，发现二者星族老(约9 Gyr)但ICL更贫金属、速度分布迥异，并可与核芯暗物质晕模型及强透镜结果比较，为检验暗物质本质提供新途径。
AI.motivation: ICL与BCG的测光分解存在退化，难以区分二者成分；同时内暗物质晕轮廓难以直接约束。作者希望用运动学手段分离两个成分，既揭示ICL的恒星起源，又为检验暗物质模型提供互补途径。
AI.method: 基于MUSE积分视场光谱数据，对Abell S1063采用运动学方法分离ICL与BCG的速度分布；分析二者恒星年龄与金属丰度；进行二维Sérsic拟合给出质心偏移；并将ICL面亮度轮廓与假设核芯晕的强透镜估计及不同暗物质模型的模拟作对比。
AI.result: 两者年龄均约9 Gyr，但ICL金属丰度更低，暗示不同前身星系路径。100 kpc内ICL占BCG+ICL恒星质量的55%，显著高于测光分解估计。BCG与ICL速度分布不同且随半径近乎恒定，ICL速度弥散为BCG的两倍以上，视向速度偏移86±18 km/s；Sérsic拟合给出ICL质心相对BCG偏移5.2±1.5 kpc。这些相空间偏移表明BCG在宽势阱极小值附近振荡。ICL面亮度轮廓与核芯晕假设下的强透镜估计一致，模拟显示不同暗物质模型下内晕轮廓系统性变化。
AI.conclusion: 运动学分离方法能有效区分BCG与ICL并刻画其星族差异，且对暗物质晕内轮廓敏感；应用于更大样本可互补检验暗物质本质，同时揭示ICL的恒星起源。
